function.name: ccmon_queue_health
function.description: Get the current health of all call queues (waiting, active, agents free, SLA%) with a plain-language summary. Use when the user asks how the queues are doing, which queue is overloaded, or whether SLA is at risk. Returns a 'stale' flag — if true, mention that the collector may be down.

function.name: ccmon_agents_paused
function.description: List agents who have been paused for at least min_minutes, longest first, with a plain-language summary. Use for questions like 'who has been on break too long?' or 'list paused agents'.

function.name: ccmon_abandoned_calls
function.description: Get abandoned-call statistics for a date (default: today): total, breakdown by queue, average wait, and a plain-language summary. Use for questions like 'how many calls did we lose today/yesterday?'

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD date; defaults to today. Must not be in the future.

function.name: ccmon_report_summary
function.description: Get a traffic summary for a date range (max 92 days, no future dates): offered, answered, abandoned %, average wait and SLA%. Use for questions like 'how did we do last week?' or 'what was the SLA in September?'.

date_to.description: YYYY-MM-DD end date (inclusive); defaults to today.
